sections.googleLimitedUse: Google API Services User Data Policy

privacy.noTraining: Your email content and other data are never used to train AI models.
privacy.noAds: Your data is never sold for advertising and is never used for ad targeting.

privacy.aiOutput: AI output may be incomplete or wrong. You can check the source with “Where did this come from?”; details that can't be verified are marked “Not confirmed in the source.”
